target_customer: Single-family rental and build-to-rent investors and operators; YC page frames it as real estate sales and customer success teams
problem: Real estate investors and sales teams lack consolidated data and workflow for finding, underwriting, buying and managing properties.
business_model: Software platform plus services (brokerage, renovation, management) for SFR and BTR owners; pricing not found
product_category: Real estate investment platform and AI sales copilot

founders.name: Or Preiss
previous_startups: Zengaming (co-founder and CMO, marketplace for renting virtual gaming items; outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Education not found.

founders.name: Kobi Mantzur
founders.background_notes: YC page says over 10 years building products and managing engineering teams. Education not found.

competitors.name: Roofstock
competitors.what: Online marketplace and platform for buying and managing single-family rentals
competitors.funding_then: Series E in March 2022 at a reported $1.9B valuation, led by SoftBank (aggregator source)

competitors.name: ZoomInfo
competitors.what: B2B contact and sales intelligence data, named by the YC page as the analogy

competitors.name: Apollo
competitors.what: Sales intelligence and engagement platform, named by the YC page as the analogy

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and entity-resolving real estate data and running underwriting and workflow is standard engineering with hard data work. The LLM engine described on the YC page postdates the batch.

defensibility.rationale: The claimed proprietary dataset of consolidated real estate entities could compound, but data vendors and platforms like Roofstock are well funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources.

market_need_then: The YC page claims Fortune 500 and mid-market users. Demand evidence at founding is not documented beyond the growth of institutional single-family rental investing.

branding.domain_note: Uses getzorba.com, a prefixed .com, so zorba.com was not obtained.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional and polished, AI and efficiency focus

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search found no press about the brand or its origin. The name overlaps with other uses such as the old Zara name.

outcome_analysis: Zorba is still active and its site now positions it as an all in one SFR and BTR investment platform, while its YC description is an AI copilot for real estate sales teams, which suggests the positioning shifted over time. No funding beyond YC is confirmed, and no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found, so the outcome is unclear.
notes: Aggregators disagree on funding: Startupim lists $2.2M pre-seed (2020), CB Insights lists $0.5M convertible note on 2022-03-29. Both unverified single aggregator figures, so no round is recorded. Founding year 2021 per YC, 2020 per aggregators. Spelling Mantzur vs Manzur varies. Apollo and ZoomInfo have no dated source.
